facts.text: I want to add an authorized user to my card.
I am in a rush to receive my new credit card soon.
I want to check the current progress of my credit card application.

keyphrases: call number on back of card
receive new credit card in 7 to 10 business days

events.text: Get a response to a credit card application within about 60 seconds when applying by phone or online
Receive a written decision within 7 to 10 days after a credit card application
Receive a new credit card, credit limit information, and welcome materials by mail within approximately 7 to 10 business days if approved
For a Secured Mastercard, pay the deposit in full before the card ships, then receive it in approximately 7 to 10 business days
